name: Rate limiter
pitch: Add rate limiting and circuit breaker patterns to a service client to prevent overload and handle failures gracefully.
instructions:
Implement rate limiting and circuit breaker patterns for the service client code in this workspace.

Start by listing the files in the current directory to understand the codebase structure.
Read the main service client file to understand its current implementation and how requests are made.
Identify suitable locations to add rate limiting logic, typically using a token bucket or fixed window algorithm.
Implement a rate limiter that tracks request counts and enforces delays between requests based on the service's limits.
Add a circuit breaker that monitors request failures and temporarily blocks requests when a threshold is reached, then allows a test request to see if the service recovered.
Write the updated code to the service client file, preserving existing functionality.
If the codebase uses existing libraries for these patterns, check for them before writing custom implementations.
When the implementation is complete, show the added code sections and explain how they protect the service client from overload and repeated failures.

examples.does: displays the rate limiter implementation with comments

skills.name: add-rate-limiting
skills.description: Add rate limiting to prevent too many requests in a given time window.
skills.body: 1. Check the current request rate in the codebase. 2. Choose a rate limiting algorithm (token bucket or fixed window). 3. Add a counter that increments on each request. 4. Enforce a delay or block when the limit is reached. 5. Reset the counter after the time window expires.

skills.name: add-circuit-breaker
skills.description: Add a circuit breaker to stop requests when the service is unhealthy.
skills.body: 1. Track recent request outcomes (successes and failures). 2. Set a failure threshold that trips the circuit. 3. When tripped, block new requests and return an error or cached response. 4. After a cooldown period, allow a single test request. 5. Close the circuit if the test request succeeds, otherwise re-trip.

readme:
# Rate limiter
Adds rate limiting and circuit breaker patterns to a service client.

Protects the service from overload and handles temporary failures gracefully.

Needs access to the service client source files.

Will not make external requests or modify production configurations.
